_comment: Dataset class -> canonical ingredient name in public.ingredients.

straight into the same matcher that manual entry uses. A prediction of
'capsicum' is useless if the catalogue calls it 'bell pepper'.
Scope is deliberately fresh produce only. Staples like salt, oil and
turmeric are typed once during onboarding and marked as pantry staples;
